# Supplementary Figure 4 — XCL1 (lymphotactin)

Metamorphic switch of XCL1 between its **monomeric chemokine fold (2HDM)** and the
**dimeric β-sandwich (2JP1)**, scored by TM-score to each reference.

**Method (divide-and-conquer → occurrence voting).** Clade-based divide-and-conquer spreads
the MSA; occurrence voting enriches the dimeric (2JP1) state; the top-16 sequences are
re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds = 40 structures), against a random control.

**Figure** = `three_panel_tmscore_2hdm_2jp1.png`, generated by
`results_updated/XCL1/run2/replot_three_panel_tmscore.py`. Sources copied (read-only) from
`results_updated/XCL1/run2/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| Divide & Conquer | `panel1_divide_and_conquer_structure_analysis.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 12,850 |
| Dimeric (2JP1) top-16 | `panel2_2jp1_dimeric_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_2jp1/results/top_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Random control | `panel3_random_control.csv` | `occurrence_voting_2jp1/results/random_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |

References: `2HDM_model1.pdb` (monomeric), `2JP1_model1.pdb` (dimeric); config `config_2hdm_2jp1_tmscore.json` (span res 1–92).
